about: Visible words per page in <main> on a phone (chromium-mobile), counted by text-budget.spec.ts. The rule is a heading plus at most one sentence per card; setup steps and long explanations sit behind the card's own disclosure. Lower a number when a page gets shorter; raise one only in a reviewed change that says why the words are needed. Measured against a seeded demo record on 2026-11-27 before the ceilings were set. Insights pages are left out: their words are the record's data and model text, not the page's copy.
